sn12.36:1.4: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti || || 3
sn12.36:2.1: Katamaṃ jarāmaraṇaṃ kassa ca panidaṃ jarāmaraṇanti iti vā bhikkhave yo vadeyya || aññaṃ jarāmaraṇam aññassa ca panidam jarāmaraṇanti iti vā bhikkhave yo vadeyya || ubhayam etam ekattham vyañjanam eva nānam || ||
sn12.36:2.2: Taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīranti vā bhikkhave diṭṭhiyā sati brahmacariyavāso na hoti ||
sn12.36:2.3: aññam jīvam aññaṃ sarīranti vā bhikkhave diṭṭhiyā sati brahmacariyavāso nā hoti || ||
sn12.36:2.4: Ete te bhikkhave ubho ante anupagamma majjhena Tathāgato dhammaṃ deseti
sn12.36:3.10: Katame saṅkhārā kassa ca panime saṅkhārā ti iti vā bhikkhave yo vadeyya || aññe saṅkhārā aññassa ca panime saṅkhārā ti iti vā bhikkhave yo vadeyya || ubhayam etam ekattam vyañjanam eva nāṇaṃ ||
sn12.36:3.11: Taṃ jīvam taṃ sarīram iti vā bhikkhave diṭṭhiyā sati brahmacariyavāso no hoti ||
sn12.36:3.12: aññaṃ jīvam aññaṃ sarīram iti vā bhikkhave ditthiyā sati brahmacariyavāso na hoti || ||
sn12.36:3.13: Ete te bhikkhave ubho ante anupagamma majjhena Tathāgato dhammaṃ deseti
sn12.36:5.11: Katame saṅkhārā kassa ca panime saṅkhārā iti vā || || Aññe saṅkhārā aññassa ca panime saṅkhārā iti vā || || Taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīram iti vā || || Sabbānissitāni
sn12.36:5.12: pahināni bhavanti ucchinnamūlāni tālavatthukatāni anabhāvakatāni āyatim anupādadhammānīti || ||
